Question: The function \(f\) has the property that for each real number \(x\) in its domain, \(\frac{1}{x}\) is also in its domain and \[ f(x) + f\!\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) = x. \] What is the largest set of real numbers that can be in the domain of \(f?\)
